newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Qinghai Aluminium plans H share offer this year.
newsitem.headline: Qinghai Aluminium plans H share offer this year.

text.p: China's Qinghai Aluminium Industry Co Ltd plans to make an offer of H shares -- shares listed in Hong Kong -- to raise one to 1.5 billion yuan, a company official said on Tuesday.

The company, based in Xining, capital of the remote northwestern Qinghai province, is among 38 enterprises recently chosen by the Securities Commission of the State Council as candidates for listing abroad.
The number of shares to be offered and the issue's pricing are not yet fixed, with an underwriter yet to be selected, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.

The firm, a unit under the China National Nonferrous Metals Industry Corporation, forecast its electrolytic aluminium output at 150,000 tonnes for 1997 against 112,000 tonnes last year, the official said.
If the H share offer goes through, the firm would use the share proceeds to buy a facility in Qinghai capable of producing 100,000 tonnes of electrolytic aluminium a year, he said.
He did not give the company's share capital or business results.
